_notice: SAMPLE DATA - VERIFY BEFORE PRODUCTION USE. Consult local FSSAI food safety guidelines before deploying.

cooked_rice_dish.label: Cooked Rice Dish (Biryani, Pulao, Khichdi)
cooked_rice_dish.notes: Cooked rice must be delivered within 2 hours at ambient temperature or 12 hours if kept chilled below 5°C.

cooked_curry_dal.label: Cooked Curry, Dal & Sabzi
cooked_curry_dal.notes: Hot cooked curries and dals must be rescued within 3 hours at room temperature.

breads_rotis.label: Rotis, Naan & Bakery Breads
breads_rotis.notes: Dry flatbreads and baked goods stay safe up to 8 hours in clean, covered packaging.

dairy_sweets.label: Dairy-Based Sweets & Desserts (Rasmalai, Kheer, Barfi)
dairy_sweets.notes: Milk-based sweets spoil quickly in warm weather; max 4 hours ambient or 24 hours chilled.

cut_fruit_salad.label: Cut Fruit & Raw Salads
cut_fruit_salad.notes: Cut produce has a strict 2-hour ambient window to prevent bacterial growth.

packaged_dry_staples.label: Sealed Packaged Dry Staples & Snacks
packaged_dry_staples.notes: Factory-sealed dry goods with intact packaging and valid best-before dates.

raw_meat_seafood.label: Raw Meat, Poultry or Seafood
raw_meat_seafood.notes: High-risk raw animal protein is blocked from peer-to-peer rescue for food safety compliance.

unpasteurized_dairy.label: Unpasteurized Milk or Open Cream
unpasteurized_dairy.notes: Unpasteurized or open liquid dairy is blocked due to rapid pathogen risk.
